map.Galaxy Dual delivered about 54% of all t: Galaxy Dual delivered about 54% of all the clicks (83,239) at PKR 1.95 per click. Luxeed was the cheapest at PKR 1.63. The gap is around 20% (calculated). A common reason is that as a campaign reaches more people, it moves beyond its cheapest audiences. We do not have the audience data to say whether that happened here.
map.Weighting each campaign by its clicks gi: Weighting each campaign by its clicks gives a blended cost of about PKR 1.85 per click and a total spend of roughly PKR 287,000. Both are calculated from the figures above.
map.A link click shows interest, not a purch: A link click shows interest, not a purchase. A solar business needs enquiries and quotes, so clicks are the first number to check, not the last.
